description: List every comment on a pull request in chronological order: general comments (kind `issue_comment`), inline review comments (`review_comment`: path, line, thread {id, inReplyToId, position, replies, resolved, resolvedAt, resolvedBy}) and review summaries (`review`: state approved | changes_requested | commented). Each entry has author {login, type user|bot}, isAi (written by an AI reviewer), body, createdAt, updatedAt. A review thread is the inline comments on one file+line; the earliest is its root and holds the resolved state. Gluecron does not store a review comment's commit or diff side, so `commitId` and `side` are always null. Only approved (moderated) comments; unsubmitted draft reviews are private to their author and not listed. `kind`: all (default) | issue | review (review comments + review summaries). `since`: ISO-8601 — only entries updated at or after it. Paged: `total` is the full filtered count, `nextOffset` pages through it. Works anonymously on public repos; private repos need read access.

kind.description: all (default) | issue (general comments) | review (review comments + review summaries)

offset.description: Entries to skip. Use `nextOffset` from the previous response.

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only entries updated at or after it

name: gluecron_list_pr_comments
